reason: 该插件主要用途是为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供可视化桌面宠物体验，围绕界面展示、角色动画与互动面板进行扩展，属于主题/布局类前端增强；当前证据未显示外部服务接入、网络访问或自动化执行能力，风险主要为本地客户端交互与存储行为。

summaries.zh: 这是一个为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 增加可拖拽 Live2D 看板娘的插件，支持角色与换装切换、台词互动和 PNG 截图。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a draggable Live2D desktop mascot to the DeepSeek Harness web interface, with character/outfit switching, speech interactions, and PNG screenshot capture.

capabilities: Injects a Live2D pet widget into the DeepSeek Harness web interface
Allows dragging and persistent positioning via browser localStorage
Provides character selection and outfit switching UI controls
Supports speech bubble interaction and PNG screenshot capture
Loads and serves bundled local media assets from the plugin package

reasons.code: README describes a right-bottom Live2D mascot rendered in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with drag-move positioning and interaction features.

README states model data and assets are loaded locally with same-origin loading and that model resources are included under repository assets, indicating local media handling and client-side rendering.
README lists features including photo capture/export to PNG, outfit/character switching, and bubble dialogue, confirming media and UI-facing interaction capabilities.
package.json declares dsh client platform as web and exposes dsh bundle patch entrypoints, confirming this is a web UI plugin rather than a backend or service integration.
